body.overview:
Clayox helps early childhood education centres run admissions, attendance, daily care updates, family messaging, and invoice-first billing from one platform. Each centre gets a dedicated deployment so operations stay organised without juggling spreadsheets and disconnected tools.

For the complete product experience, visit Clayox childcare management software. That is the primary Clayox website. This IGENTX page is only a concise summary for people exploring our products.

Prices in USD. Clayox software on its own is from $0.99 per student per month, billed annually, with a minimum of 20 students. See Clayox pricing for full terms. A website, hosting, professional email, SEO and an AI enquiry assistant (Starter and up) are available through the IGENTX Childcare Digital Partnership. The Clayox interface is English, with AI message translation into 100+ languages including Arabic. Billing supports AED and other GCC currencies (SAR, QAR, KWD, BHD, OMR) with configurable VAT.

Clayox is a progressive web app today, not a native mobile app, and online card payments are not available yet. To plan Clayox alongside a centre website or AI enquiry work, Book a Free Consultation with IGENTX.
